gates.finding: A specific proportional-dimensional compensated-loss boundary is the candidate contribution. Established support geometry, PPI, variance weighting and conic tools are attributed. Closest formal article and its growing-dimension appendix still require comparison.

Choice-logit targets, whole menus and two released choice studies connect the work to choice analysis. Failures concentrate at small label budgets; prediction superiority is not demonstrated. Scope match does not alone establish sufficient contribution.
Current hashes bind completed proofs, checks and diagnostic records. This source-reading review does not amount to independent expert proof certification or rule out all possible errors.

The public panel study has 298 respondents; allocation repetitions are not new people. Private questionnaire channels are confounded and AI pretests are excluded. Larger food-DCE label budgets have no failures; the all-human training-cost comparator is stronger.
Existing ridge, Firth, pooling, regular power tuning and one-step comparisons are retained. Fixed tuning and conditional availability limit rankings; no generally superior new estimator is claimed.

The reviewed isolated archive passes inventory, provenance and table reconciliation. Current canonical Word hashes and all 808 preceding scientific file hashes remain identical. No unchanged computation was repeated during this review.

All 75 full and 31 reading pages are bound to visual review; abstract 189 words, body 9417 lexical words under the recorded rule. No full-article word cap was verified. No external similarity-service scan or global no-plagiarism certificate exists.

Manuscript, author facts, disclosures, highlights, cover letter and figures are prepared. Author approval, originality/exclusive-submission confirmations and publisher portal declarations remain later author actions.
